knowledge.title: Product knowledge
knowledge.description: Product sheets, general terms and tariff information Clara looks up product details in. She only uses the active version of each document.
knowledge.productEmpty: No documents. Clara does not answer detailed questions about this product itself.
knowledge.documentCount: {count, plural, =0 {No documents} one {# document} other {# documents}}
knowledge.sections: {count, plural, one {# section read} other {# sections read}}
knowledge.processingHint: v{version} is being read. This usually takes less than a minute.
knowledge.confirmDelete: Delete “{title}” with all its versions? Clara will no longer use it.

upload.title: Add a document
upload.description: A new document becomes active as soon as it has been read. To update an existing one, upload a new version there.
upload.fileHint: PDF up to 10 MB and 40 pages, stored encrypted.
upload.done: Uploaded. Clara uses the document as soon as it has been read.

errors.too_large: The file is larger than 10 MB.
errors.too_many_pages: The PDF has more than 40 pages.
errors.invalid_fields: Please enter product, type and title.
errors.generic: The upload did not work. Please try again.

test.title: Test the lookup
test.description: Shows which passages Clara finds for a question.
test.question: Keywords
test.none: No matching passage. Clara would not confirm this.
test.noDocuments: There are no active documents for this product.

improvements.title: Improvements
improvements.description: Pax reads the conversations, finds recurring problems and proposes changes. Nothing becomes active by itself: you decide on every proposal.
improvements.running: Analysing the conversations of the last {window}. This takes about a minute.
improvements.interrupted: The analysis was interrupted. Start it again.
improvements.noRun: No analysis yet. Start one to get proposals.
improvements.noConversations: There were no conversations in this period.

stats.npsCount: {count, plural, =0 {no ratings} one {# rating} other {# ratings}}

improvements.openEmpty: No open proposals. Start an analysis once new conversations have come in.
improvements.evidence: {count, plural, one {Seen in # conversation} other {Seen in # conversations}}
improvements.acceptedRule: Waiting in the rule editor. Active only once you save a new version.
improvements.acceptedKnowledge: Add the missing facts to the product knowledge.
improvements.acceptedPrompt: Noted for the team that maintains the conversation design.

flags.title: Flagged conversations
flags.description: Flagged as not good by advisors. Included in every analysis until resolved.

flag.title: Conversation quality
flag.description: Did the conversation not go well? Flag it with a short note. The note feeds into the analysis under Improvements.
flag.label: What did not go well?
flag.placeholder: e.g. Quoted premiums before the situation was clear
flag.error: Describe in a few words what did not go well.

ruleDraft.banner: Rule draft from Improvements: “{title}”. Review and adjust it. It only becomes active once you save the new version.
ruleDraft.pendingHelp: Accepted proposals that are not in any version yet.
